author: incidence-engine
body_markdown: `IE-L-COMPONENT-LIFT` imports the generic whole-relation lift from `researcher-0001:P7.1`. For each component, $B(X,Y,Q_\Gamma)=0$ gives $Z-Q_\Gamma\mid B$; hence at most $\deg_ZB\le D/d$ distinct component polynomials occur, and edge pigeonholing yields one global $Q$. This adopts `E2E-21`--`E2E-23` and removes the former irreducible-factor seed obligation from the primary path; simple-root cleanup remains essential.
subject: Component templates replace factor lift
